display.purpose: Presume wordmark and rare product-level identity only.

headline.purpose: Major panel results and high-value state headings.

title.purpose: Fit, Review, toolbar groups, and local surface headings.

body.purpose: Explanatory content, evidence, and settings descriptions.

label.purpose: Buttons, compact controls, status metadata, and field labels.

document.purpose: Resume canvas and exported PDF only.

shadows.name: inset-edge
shadows.purpose: Restrained top highlight on structural Dark-mode surfaces.

shadows.name: structural-ambient
shadows.purpose: Major Fit, Review, and command-rail surfaces at wide layouts.

shadows.name: masthead-ambient
shadows.purpose: Separates the full-width masthead from the workbench.

shadows.name: document-ambient
shadows.purpose: The strongest elevation, reserved for the resume paper.

motion.name: state-standard
motion.purpose: Hover, focus-adjacent, disclosure, and ordinary state transitions.

motion.name: review-sweep
motion.purpose: Three-pixel bottom-edge progress sweep while Review is running.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Replace motion with an immediate state change and a static full-width Review indicator.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single highest-emphasis action in a local action group.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #6bc8bd; border-radius: 4px; color: #f7fffd; background: #14796f; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.22), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.34); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0f685f; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6bc8bd; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A neutral document or panel action that supports the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #46534e; border-radius: 4px; color: #f0f3f1; background: #202825; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.12), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.25); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #6b7974; background: #252e2b; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6bc8bd; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Structural Shell
components.description: A major Fit, Review, or command surface defined by tonal depth and a precise edge.
components.css: .ds-shell { width: 320px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #34403c; border-radius: 2px; color: #f0f3f1; background: #1a211f; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.075), 0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.14); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-shell header { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -.01em; } .ds-shell p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: #aab4b0; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.25; }

components.name: Fit Stepper
components.description: A single segmented control for constraints; the unit remains in the external label.
components.html: 1
components.css: .ds-stepper { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 34px 44px 34px; height: 34px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #46534e; border-radius: 4px; background: #151b19; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-stepper button, .ds-stepper output { display: grid; place-items: center; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid #34403c; color: #f0f3f1; background: transparent; font: inherit; } .ds-stepper button:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-stepper button:hover { background: #202825; } .ds-stepper button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6bc8bd; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Review Running
components.description: A stable Review row whose three-pixel bottom sweep communicates progress.
components.css: .ds-review-running { position: relative; display: flex; width: 320px; height: 54px; align-items: center; padding: 0 14px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #32675f; border-radius: 2px; color: #67c8bd; background: #142522; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-review-sweep { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; height: 3px; overflow: hidden; background: rgba(46,158,145,.2); } .ds-review-sweep::after { position: absolute; width: 38%; height: 100%; background: #2e9e91; content: ""; animation: ds-review-progress 1600ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-review-progress { from { transform: translateX(-120%); } to { transform: translateX(320%); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-review-sweep::after { width: 100%; opacity: .55; animation: none; transform: none; } }

components.name: Theme Control
components.description: A compact System, Light, or Dark choice placed after Saved locally in the masthead.
components.css: .ds-theme-control { display: inline-flex; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid #46534e; border-radius: 4px; background: #151b19; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-theme-control button { height: 30px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; color: #aab4b0; background: transparent; font: 600 11.5px/1 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-theme-control button[aria-checked="true"] { color: #f0f3f1; background: #202825; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.12), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.34); } .ds-theme-control button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6bc8bd; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Resume Paper
components.description: The fixed Letter document remains warm white and typographically independent in every app theme.
components.css: .ds-resume { width: 408px; height: 528px; padding: 24px; color: #101827; background: #fffefb; box-shadow: 0 18px 46px rgba(31,52,45,.16); font-family: "EB Garamond", Garamond, Georgia, serif; } .ds-resume h2 { margin: 0 0 20px; text-align: center; font-size: 24px; line-height: 1; } .ds-resume h3 { margin: 18px 0 8px; padding-bottom: 2px; border-bottom: 1px solid #101827; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: .055em; } .ds-resume p { margin: 3px 0; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.2; }

narrative.overview: Presume is a calm, exacting instrument built around a document—not a dashboard that happens to contain one. The interface should feel engineered, coherent, and quietly premium: aligned like a drafting surface, materially consistent like a well-made tool, and restrained enough that the resume remains the visual anchor. The full-width masthead establishes the product, while the desktop workbench resolves into three deliberate zones: a 320px Fit surface, a center command rail and fixed 816 × 1056px resume, and a 320px Review surface. Through 1639px, Fit moves above the editor and Review moves below it. This reflow is graceful degradation, not a shift in product priority; the desktop document workbench remains primary and the fixed resume scrolls only inside its designated canvas on narrow screens. Light and Dark themes are equally authoritative. The first visit follows the system setting, and an explicit Light, Dark, or System choice persists. The resume paper remains warm white in every app theme, preserving the independence of the editable and exported artifact.
keyCharacteristics: Document-led hierarchy with application chrome in a supporting role.
Rectilinear geometry: 2px structural shells and 4px controls.
Restrained Verdigris used for action, selection, focus, and active Review states.
Layered precision through borders, tonal surfaces, inset highlights, and sparse ambient shadow.
Progressive disclosure for Fit and Review rather than permanent information density.
State motion that communicates progress without decorating the workspace.

rules.name: The Document Anchor Rule
rules.body: The resume must remain the dominant visual object at desktop and laptop widths. No application surface may compete with its contrast, scale, or central placement.

rules.name: The Desktop-First Rule
rules.body: Wide-screen composition is the primary design. Narrow-screen base styles are an implementation technique for deterministic breakpoints, never a reason to redesign the product as mobile-first.

rules.name: The Ten-Percent Rule
rules.body: Verdigris should occupy no more than roughly ten percent of a normal screen. Its rarity gives it authority.

rules.name: The Semantic Isolation Rule
rules.body: Amber, green, and red communicate status only. They are forbidden as ornamental accents or section colors.

rules.name: The Paper Independence Rule
rules.body: App theme changes never tint the resume. The editable document and exported PDF remain warm white with dark ink.

rules.name: The One Application Voice Rule
rules.body: All application text—including the Presume wordmark, Review scores, labels, buttons, and steppers—uses Geist. No second UI or display family is permitted.

rules.name: The Document Boundary Rule
rules.body: EB Garamond never leaks into application chrome, and Geist never replaces the resume font through ordinary theme work. A document-font change requires explicit browser/PDF wrapping, pagination, extraction, and fit validation.

rules.name: The Borders-Before-Shadows Rule
rules.body: A one-pixel border and tonal contrast must explain a surface before shadow is added. If shadow is doing the structural work, the component is over-elevated.

rules.name: The No Glass Rule
rules.body: Blur, translucent glass panels, liquid-glass distortion, and glow-heavy surfaces are prohibited. Premium finish comes from exact edges and controlled highlights.

dos: Do keep the fixed resume visually dominant and centered within its stage.
Do use Geist for every application role and EB Garamond only for the resume/PDF.
Do use 2px structural corners, 4px control corners, and one-pixel borders consistently.
Do make Light and Dark themes complete peers and persist System, Light, or Dark preference.
Do reserve Verdigris for primary action, selection, focus, progress, and active Review state.
Do preserve clear hover, active, disabled, focus-visible, loading, success, warning, and error states.
Do keep motion between 150–250ms for ordinary state changes and provide a reduced-motion alternative.
Do treat narrow layouts as graceful degradation while keeping touch-critical controls usable and page-level overflow absent.
Do keep Fit above the editor and Review below it through 1639px; maintain the wide three-zone workbench from 1640px.
donts: Don't create generic clickbait SaaS dashboards or template-heavy shadcn defaults.
Don't make the interface excessively rounded, soft, glassy, or decorative.
Don't create card-heavy layouts where every region receives equal visual weight.
Don't add marketing-style visual noise, ornamental animation, or oversized controls.
Don't build a resume editor that treats the document as a secondary preview pane.
Don't create automated-writing experiences that obscure or surrender user control.
Don't use decorative vertical accent strips, glow-heavy edges, gradient text, beige parchment app backgrounds, or blue merely because it is a familiar software accent.
Don't add redundant text when a button, title, or state label already communicates the same information.
Don't use a rounded pill for ordinary buttons, status rows, or disclosure controls.
Don't change src/styles/resume.css, resume geometry, PDF typography, or JSON structure as collateral to application-theme work.
